chunks: And in the narration of ʿĀmir ibn ʿAbdullāh, he said: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:

There was a palm branch over the grave of Ibrāhīm, son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, which shaded it from the sun wherever it moved. Then when the branch dried up, the trace of the grave disappeared, and its place was no longer known.

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.عِذْقٌ: a palm branch or palm stalk

ai.seo_question: What happened to the grave of Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This narration reports that the grave of Ibrāhīm, the son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, was marked by a palm branch that shaded it from the sun. When that branch dried, the visible trace of the grave vanished, and its precise location became unknown, preserving a historical memory connected to the Prophet’s family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4736 - In the narration of ʿAmir ibn ʿAbdullah, he said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "

There was a palm branch (ʿadhq) over the grave of Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family), that shaded it from the sun wherever it moved. When the branch dried up, the trace of the grave disappeared, and its exact location became unknown."
